property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer reverts if any external transferFrom call to the callee reverts; the mutant that ignores failed external calls will sometimes not revert (violating this rule) when the callee reverts.
change_summary: Remove the revert on failed external calls and instead continue (delete the revert branch), so calls that previously reverted now succeed (if any later code doesn't revert).
